programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 2
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Aurora - Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: In the earth’s polar regions, a ghostly flicker and colourful glow often brighten the night sky. Whoever sees an aurora event will never forget this impressive experience. Finland’s Saami people, Alaska’s Inuit, Canada’s Native Americans and New Zealand’s Maori all have legends about the origins and meaning of this magic natural spectacle. These stories tell of spirits dancing in the sky, of a bright and better world where hunting game is abundant, of battling gods and celestial messages.

programme.title: Faroe Islands - A Secret Beauty
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Gronland - In the Glare of Ice
programme.desc: Greenland is the largest island in the world and the landmass closest to the North Pole. 80% of the country is covered by a layer of ice up to 3000 meters thick. Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: Iceland - On Top of the World
programme.desc: A scenic expedition through majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, powerful waterfalls, threatening fjords and almighty glaciers. Hardly any other country offers such a variety of spectacular forces of nature! We will give you an insight on how it can be that the people of a small, distant island with only a fraction of sunlight in some months are happier than the people in more sun-blessed countries.

programme.title: mareTV: Sweden's High Coast
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the "stinky fish" then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of "rotten fish" is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 1
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

Most of the inhabitants of the country are spread over the breathtaking landscape of the ice-free west coast. The country is mostly inhabited by Inuit, who have been feeding on what nature has provided them for thousands of years. But the original life is in a state of change. The modernisation of society and man-made global warming threaten the Arctic natural paradise that is so incredibly important for our planet. Through the eyes of locals we get to know the authentic Greenland.

programme.title: Iceland - On Top of the World
programme.desc: A scenic expedition through majestic volcanoes, seething geysers, powerful waterfalls, threatening fjords and almighty glaciers. Hardly any other country offers such a variety of spectacular forces of nature! We will give you an insight on how it can be that the people of a small, distant island with only a fraction of sunlight in some months are happier than the people in more sun-blessed countries.

programme.title: mareTV: Sweden's High Coast
programme.desc: Sweden's Höga Kusten (High Coast) has been rising by almost one centimetre per year since the last ice age 10,000 years ago. This has created a hilly Baltic Sea landscape on the Gulf of Bothnia with small and large islands. Untouched nature, dense forests and energetic, rather idiosyncratic islanders have plenty of room there. Every year at the end of August a biting stench mixes with the fresh Baltic Sea breeze. For weeks the so-called sour herring, Swedish: Surströmming, is fermented in brine. Ruben Madsen is a producer of surströmming and an absolute connoisseur. In his wooden hut on the island of Ulvön he puts the herring in according to a traditional recipe. At the start of the season, the cans are opened for the first time. Lovers of the "stinky fish" then come from all over the world to taste the now world-famous delicacy in cans. Opening the cans of "rotten fish" is considered internationally as a test of courage, people film themselves doing so, the inhabitants of the High Coast can only smile about it.

programme.title: Wild Skagerrak
programme.desc: The strait that connects the North Sea with the Baltic, with depths of over 700 metres, is notorious for its dangerously strong currents. But currents also mean food and therefore nourishment for the large swarms of fish that inhabit the region. The sea grass meadows are comparable with those off the Californian coast. Harbour seals, grey seals and orcas hunt here, as do the rare black mouth cat shark and porpoises. Close by, catfish mate, which in itself is quite spectacular and never caught on film in this way before. Lion's mane jellyfish with nettle threads of up to 30 metres in length make their way through the open sea. Skagerrak's coastal regions are amongst the most beautiful and varied in Europe and boast one of the world's great bird paradises. Oystercatchers, sandwich and arctic terns are more plentiful here than anywhere else in Europe. The infinitely long dune landscape of the Skagerrak, is Denmark's answer to the skerries of the Swedish and Norwegian coasts. Large seal colonies can be found in the isolation of the small, picturesque islands and one can come face to face with the animals. In this rough, yet infinitely beautiful landscape, the many streams and rivers that open out into the Skagerrak, are quite remarkable. We accompany salmon in an equally beautiful river landscape and meet with ospreys and sea eagles and eventually come face to face with a brown bear mother and her little ones.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 1
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.sub-title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten: Episode 2
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Europe's far North - Lofoten and the Arctic Ocean
programme.desc: Lofoten is the rugged archipelago in the Norwegian Arctic Ocean. Whoever arrives here is really at the end. Moskenes is the end of the line, and anyone who wants to go further needs a boat or a plane. The only way to get to the open sea is via the Maelstrom, which is quite dangerous. On the outermost headland, there are only a few ruins left. The last inhabitants are long gone, a supply was hardly possible. But fishermen are on the way, mainly to catch cod. And there is the coastal administration, which takes care of broken sea marks and lighthouses. A visit to one of the luxurious ships of the Hurtig Line is not to be missed. They shuttle off rough coasts on an eleven-day trip between the Russian border and southern Norway. A floating workplace for a wide variety of professions. The island of Andøya is not served by the Hurtiglinie. It lies too far out in the Atlantic. One of the most important observatories in Europe is located here. A young woman, Sandra Blindheim, is the boss. She is responsible for the large laser that delivers important information to scientists around the world. On clear winter nights, there is a wonderful panoramic view of the aurora borealis.

programme.title: Winter Journey to the Polar Circle (Exploring Norway on the Nordlandsbanen)
programme.desc: The Nordland Railway in Norway, travels from Trondheim through the isolated regions of Trendelag and Nordland. After Mo I Rana, it traverses the Arctic Circle and ends in the northern Norwegian town of Bodø. The railway covers a distance of some 729 kilometres, passing by dense, snow-covered forests, frozen fjords and snow-capped mountains. Temperatures of sometimes minus 30 degrees are quite normal here for months, on many days there is no more than five hours of daylight. Kindergarten teacher Kaia Aarstrand und her husband, Bjørnar, a technician for the municipality, live with their four boys in Aursletta, deep within the Vistenfjord, far away from civilization. All made possible by the Norwegian state: electricity, mobile phone connection and a speedboat that brings the family to school and to work. But when the Vistenfjord freezes up, the family is isolated for days. Tormod Schøning spends hours on end on his Saltfjellet whenever snowstorms occur and he has to clear the only road connection between North and South Norway with his snow plough. For the duration of his shifts, Tormod lives in the snow plough station.

programme.title: Aurora - Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: In the earth’s polar regions, a ghostly flicker and colourful glow often brighten the night sky. Whoever sees an aurora event will never forget this impressive experience. Finland’s Saami people, Alaska’s Inuit, Canada’s Native Americans and New Zealand’s Maori all have legends about the origins and meaning of this magic natural spectacle. These stories tell of spirits dancing in the sky, of a bright and better world where hunting game is abundant, of battling gods and celestial messages.

programme.title: Faroe Islands - A Secret Beauty
programme.desc: The Faroe Islands in the North Atlantic, located in the middle of the Gulf Stream between Scotland and Iceland, are an archipelago of eighteen green volcanic islands where a unique culture has developed over the last thousand years. As direct descendants of the Vikings, the Faroese feel committed to their traditions and hold on to customs, without missing out on the advantages of the modern and globalised world - from archaic hunter and shepherd culture to contemporary art. With the highest birth rate in Europe and the lowest social inequality in the world, the just fifty thousand Faroese are a very special people living on one of the last natural paradises in Europe.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 13
programme.desc: Elle Macpherson and the judges join the three finalists on a Toronto beach for a tribal-themed shoot. The remaining two then take part in a fashion show where one of the girls is crowned the winner.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 1
programme.desc: Dannii Minogue joins host Elle Macpherson and Tyson Beckford as 28 hopefuls begin their battle for a modelling contract with a leading agency. The girls pull out all the stops but only half of them will survive the cull.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 2
programme.desc: The contestants head to the National Wedding Show at Birmingham's NEC to be coached in the art of the catwalk by model Jade Parfitt.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 3
programme.desc: It's time for the contestants to receive their makeovers and host Elle Macpherson embraces the challenge by opting for a new look herself. After their transformations, the girls pose like professional gymnasts with Olympian Louis Smith.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 4
programme.desc: Chemistry with the camera is imperative for a top model, so to separate the sizzlers from the fizzlers, the girls must pose with male models.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 5
programme.desc: Elle Macpherson shares her top tips in a modelling workshop before Tyson challenges the girls to shine on a shoot in an ex-coal mine.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 6
programme.desc: The final ten sample the flamboyant world of high fashion in a catwalk show with unusual accessories, before bearing all for a nude shoot.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 7
programme.desc: The contestants demonstrate their acting skills in milk commercials before taking part in a photoshoot inspired by classic children's stories.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 8
programme.desc: Journalist Hilary Alexander quizzes the would-be catwalk stars on the industry they are so eager to become part of. The winners are treated to a party with former contestants including last year's winner Letitia Herod.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 9
programme.desc: Elle Macpherson enrols the seven remaining contestants in a Fashion Targets Breast Cancer catwalk event for their biggest showcase yet and they also take part in a beauty shoot with a cosmetics company.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 10
programme.desc: The six remaining girls arrive in Barbados and hit the waves for a surfing-themed tourism advert. The action remains on the water for a boat-based photoshoot with Dannii Minogue and a leading hair-care brand, ahead of the dreaded elimination.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 10
programme.desc: The six remaining girls arrive in Barbados and hit the waves for a surfing-themed tourism advert. The action remains on the water for a boat-based photoshoot with Dannii Minogue and a leading hair-care brand, ahead of the dreaded elimination.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 11
programme.desc: The final five star in a music video with Bajan pop group Cover Drive and have to learn a complicated dance routine, before Elle Macpherson challenges the contestants to model jewellery in a photoshoot set in a limestone cavern.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 11
programme.desc: The final five star in a music video with Bajan pop group Cover Drive and have to learn a complicated dance routine, before Elle Macpherson challenges the contestants to model jewellery in a photoshoot set in a limestone cavern.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 12
programme.desc: The four remaining girls compete for a place in next week's final, demonstrating what they have learnt by styling themselves for a Bajan magazine cover shoot. After that, Tyson Beckford sets the contestants a challenge at a sugar plantation.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 12
programme.desc: The four remaining girls compete for a place in next week's final, demonstrating what they have learnt by styling themselves for a Bajan magazine cover shoot. After that, Tyson Beckford sets the contestants a challenge at a sugar plantation.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 13
programme.desc: The three remaining contestants take part in their final photoshoot a Caribbean carnival-themed catwalk show infront of an audience of industry bigwigs. Elle Macpherson, Tyson Beckford and Dannii Minogue then select the winner.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Episode 13
programme.desc: The three remaining contestants take part in their final photoshoot a Caribbean carnival-themed catwalk show infront of an audience of industry bigwigs. Elle Macpherson, Tyson Beckford and Dannii Minogue then select the winner.

programme.desc: En vårdag 2011 träffas Abbi och Ilana för första gången.

programme.title: Broad City: Twaining Day
programme.desc: Abbis kortvariga återkomst till Soulstice blir intressant när hon får chansen hon alltid har drömt om. Ilana får nytt jobb på en restaurang.

programme.title: Broad City: Just the Tips
programme.desc: Ilana shoppar loss med sina servitrispengar, och Abbi njuter av ett nytt förhållande. Senare på kvällen träffar tjejerna en gammal kompis på en fest.

programme.title: Broad City: Mushrooms
programme.desc: Abbi och Ilana tar svampar och får en händelserik tripp.

programme.title: Broad City: Abbi's Mom
programme.desc: Abbis mamma är på besök i stan, och Ilana försöker klara den hektiska arbetskulturen på Sushi Mambeaux medan hon hanterar sin årstidsbundna depression.

programme.title: Broad City: Witches
programme.desc: Abbi känner sig gammal när hon upptäcker ett grått hår. Ilana träffar en sexterapeut.

programme.title: Broad City: Florida
programme.desc: Abbi, Ilana, Eliot och Bobbi åker till Florida för att städa ur farmor Esthers lägenhet.

programme.title: Broad City: House Sitting
programme.desc: Abbi, Ilana, Jaime och Lincoln passar familjen Strands hus. Ilana och Lincoln definierar sin relation, och Abbi har en Bumbledejt med en man från förr.

programme.desc: En fin, ny väska ger Abbi självförtroende under arbetslösheten. Ilana och Jaimé får hantera en i New York City oundviklig mardröm.

programme.title: Broad City: Friendiversary
programme.desc: Tjejernas firande av 'kompisårsdagen' blir plötsligt farlig när de bevittnar nåt hemskt.

programme.title: Broad City: Stories
programme.desc: Abbi fyller 30. Abbi och Ilana reser genom hela Manhattan, och träffar både gamla och nya vänner.

programme.desc: Ilana sätter igång med sin senaste affärsidé: En utomhusarbetsplats för alla rökare i New York City. Abbi står på sig mot sin hyresvärd när han vägrar renovera hennes avlopp.

programme.title: Broad City: Bitcoin & the Missing Girl
programme.desc: Ilana hälsar på en gammal flamma för att få ut sin Bitcoinandel. Abbi går till en tvättomat för första gången och blir av med sin favorittröja.

programme.title: Broad City: Make the Space
programme.desc: Ilana upptäcker en hemsk hemlighet om Jaimé. Abbi försöker avancera från tröjvikare till fönsterkonstnär på Anthropologie.

programme.title: Broad City: Artsy Fartsy
programme.desc: Abbi blir inbjuden till ett fint konstevent på MoMA. Ilana och Lincoln stämmer av efter ett års förhållande.

programme.title: Broad City: Lost and Found
programme.desc: Tjejerna träffar en släkting till Ilana, en överlevare från Förintelsen, och tar med honom på dragbrunch. Abbi testar en ny look.

programme.title: Broad City: Shenanigans
programme.desc: Ilana rekryteras som hårmodell. Abbis nya kärlek påstår att hon inte är tillräckligt mogen.

programme.title: Broad City: Sleep No More
programme.desc: Abbi och Ilana åker till 'Sleep No More', och Abbi försöker hitta rätt tillfälle att berätta nåt stort för Ilana.

programme.title: Broad City: Along Came Molly
programme.desc: Abbi, Ilana och Bevers säljer Abbis saker i New York City, Abbi får biljetter till Lil Wayne, och tjejerna gör en 'tripp'.

programme.title: Broad City: Broad City
programme.desc: Brudarna säger hej då.

programme.desc: Ilana får nys om en hemlig Lil Wayne-konsert. Tillsammans med Abbi bufflar hon sig fram i New York. Tjejerna låter inget hindra dem från att skrapa ihop tillräckligt med pengar för biljetterna.

programme.title: Broad City: Stolen Phone
programme.desc: Efter att ha försökt att hitta killar på Facebook beslutar sig Abbi och Ilana att försöka hitta killar i 'verkligheten'.

programme.title: Broad City: Working Girls
programme.desc: Ilana försöker tjäna lite extrapengar i 'temp game'. Abbi lovar sin granne att vänta in hans paket, men när hon missar leveransen måste hon ta sig till världens ände för att hitta det.

programme.title: Broad City: The Lockout
programme.desc: När Abbi sanerar sin lägenhet mot ohyra och Ilana tappar bort sina nycklar tvingas tjejerna att bo på gatan - just när Abbi har sin första konstutställning.

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Kandidaten

programme.title: Gumballs fantastiska värld: Ihop parandet
programme.desc: Sarah hittar en skrivbok från Grymma Affären. Allt hon skriver i den inträffar! Olyckligtvis skriver hon ihop skruvade kärlekshistorier.

programme.title: Gumballs härligt helgalna värld: Grejen

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Sidospår: Godisanden

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Sidospår: Spelkväll

programme.title: Äventyrsdags: Sidospår: Nyckel på vift
programme.desc: Finn och Jake måste hjälpa Iskungen att hitta extranyckeln till hans slott efter att de av misstag teleporterat honom till träkojan.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!: Black Friday

programme.desc: Gumball är övertygad om att det finns ett hemligt sällskap på skolan och han vill vara med.

programme.title: Beck: Vilhelm
programme.desc: Kolme miestä murtautuu ylelliseen tukholmalaisasuntoon pukeutuneina läheteiksi. Mutta mikä vaikuttaa ryöstöltä, päättyy julmaan teloitustyylin murhaan. Vilhelm Beckin partio ehtii ensimmäisenä paikalle. Runsas teipin käyttö tuo Vilhelmin mieleen ikäviä muistoja omista panttivankikokemuksista. Vilhelm alkaa tutkia tapausta omin päin.

programme.title: Kolme sekuntia
programme.desc: Hermoja raastava trilleri, jossa Joel Kinnaman esittää entistä rikollista, joka saa tehtäväkseen mennä salaisena agenttina vankilaan.

programme.title: Peitenimi Coq Rouge
programme.desc: Ensimmäinen elokuva huippukoulutetusta tiedustelupalvelun salaisesta agentista, joka saa tehtäväkseen tutkia Ruotsissa suunniteltua operaatiota.

programme.title: Star File
programme.desc: Josh Brolin. Viihdeohjelma, jonka jokaisessa osassa piirretään muotokuva jostakin Hollywood-tähdestä, alkutaipaleelta uran huipuille ja suvantoihin. 2020

programme.title: Star File
programme.desc: Jessica Chastain. Viihdeohjelma, jonka jokaisessa osassa piirretään muotokuva jostakin Hollywood-tähdestä, alkutaipaleelta uran huipuille ja suvantoihin. 2020

programme.title: Angel
programme.desc: 80-luvulla Angelica Holst oli juhlittu rocktähti, mutta moneen vuoteen hänen levynsä eivät ole soineet hittilistoila. Hän yrittää epätoivoisesti päästä takaisin lehtien kansiin ja lavastaa oman kuolemansa. Seuraukset ovat arvaamattomat.

programme.title: Marikki
programme.desc: Marikki ei haluaisi aiheuttaa hankaluuksia, mutta toisinaan asiat eivät mene niin kuin hän oli suunnitellut. Kerrankin hän järjesti retken, joka päättyi pikkusiskon aivotärähdykseen.

programme.title: Melukylässä tapahtuu
programme.desc: Melukylä on pieni kylä Etelä-Ruotsissa ja siellä sijaitsee kolme tilaa. Välitalossa asuu Liisa ja hänen veljensä Saku ja Naku. Ylätalossa asuvat sisarukset Riitta ja Anna. Alatalossa taas Olli. Siinäpä Melukylän kaikki lapset ovatkin, mutta heissä on kyllä yhdelle kylälle ihan tarpeeksi! Nyt Melukylässä eletään syksyä ja talvea, ja joka päivä on täynnä uusia seikkailuja!

programme.title: Fake Patient
programme.desc: Förhandling. Albin herää sairaalassa. Lääkäri kertoo pelätystä aivokasvaimesta, ja Albin joutuu hätäleikkaukseen. Felix tapaa Cissin ja kertoo tilanteesta. Albin asuu Uumajassa ja tekee lisätöitä valepotilaana sairaalassa odottaessaan näyttelijänuran käynnistymistä, kun hän saa tietää olevansa oikeasti sairas. Samaan aikaan Albin on aloittanut syrjähypyn agenttinsa Cissin kanssa. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Irralliset
programme.desc: Mathilda yrittää peittää salaisuutensa Johannekselta samalla kun Martha salaa toisen ison asian Sebastianilta. Emil on innoissaan treffeille lähdöstä. Tähdillä roolitettu samannimisen 90-luvun elokuvan spin-off. Tässä modernissa draamakomediassa seuraamme 30-vuotiasta Mathildaa, joka panikoi vakaan ja värittömän aikuiselämän lähestyessä, kun hänen poikaystävänsä yllättäen kosii. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Opiskelijakämppä
programme.desc: Flora ja Larsson yrittävät piristää Jennyä viemällä hänet bileisiin. Jenny saa sovinistisika Rickardin pöytänaapuriksi ja Oliver myy huumeita. 20-vuotias Jenny jättää Eskilstunan lukeakseen psykologiksi Uppsalassa. Opiskelijakämpässä hän tapaa karismaattiset klubittajat Sagan ja Oliverin, jotka jo ensimmäisenä iltana houkuttelevat Jennyn tekemään päätöksen, jolla on tuhoisat seuraukset... Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Happy fucking Pride
programme.desc: “Load More Guys”. Dilan, Ari ja Nina tapaavat yön tapahtumien jälkeen ja joutuvat rajuun riitaan. Dilan yrittää saada Arin luottamaan itseensä mutta valehtelee taas. Tukholma kuplii odotuksia Pride-viikon alkaessa. Treffejä odottava pikkukaupungin poika Dilan, näennäisen itsevarma mutta satutettu huippumeklari Ari ja tämän juuri jätetty kaveri Nina navigoivat vauhdikkaiden kesäpäivien ja kuumien kesäöiden läpi. Ruotsi 2024

programme.title: Käsi sydämellä
programme.desc: Ava lähtee Johnin mukaan tämän perheen luo. Koko vierailun ajan häntä kuitenkin kiusaa näky, joka sai hänet epävarmaksi tulevaisuudesta Johnin kanssa. Tukholmalaisella pariterapeutilla Avalla on yliluonnollinen kyky. Laittamalla käden ihmisen sydämelle hän näkee avainhetkiä tämän tulevasta rakkauselämästä. Itse hän on menettänyt uskon rakkauteen, kunnes eräänä päivänä näkee yllättävän näyn. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Lajka
programme.desc: Rut osallistuu kiusaamisen vastaiseen kampanjaan. Hän haluaa kertoa tarinansa ja totuuden työstään, mutta kohtaa vastarintaa. Cajsa saa tarjouksen. Felicia Danielssonin ja Vera Herngrenin satiirisarja. Saamme seurata ystävysten Rutin ja Cajsan päivittäisiä haasteita influencer-maailmassa. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Misa Mi
programme.desc: Kymmenenkesäinen Misa on menettänyt äitinsä, ja hän matkustaa Arjeplogiin viettääkseen kesää isoäitinsä luona. Misan koko elämä tuntuu särkyneen. Kaikki kuitenkin muuttuu, kun hän törmää norlantilaismetsässä susiäitiin pentuineen.

programme.title: Pekka Peukaloinen
programme.desc: Pertti on yksin kotona. Hän makaa sängyllä ja tuntee olonsa yksinäiseksi. Yhtäkkiä hän kuulee sängyn alta sipsuttelevaa ääntä. Hän kumartuu katsomaan sängynreunan yli ja näkee jotakin aivan ihmeellistä: siellä on poika, joka tuskin on peukalonpäätä suurempi.

programme.title: Fake Patient
programme.desc: Depression. Syöpähoito jatkuu, mutta Albin ei halua Yvonnen tukiryhmään. Cissi ilmestyy Albinin syntymäpäiville ja tämä pakenee metsään, mistä Gunnar hänet hakee. Albin asuu Uumajassa ja tekee lisätöitä valepotilaana sairaalassa odottaessaan näyttelijänuran käynnistymistä, kun hän saa tietää olevansa oikeasti sairas. Samaan aikaan Albin on aloittanut syrjähypyn agenttinsa Cissin kanssa. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Irralliset
programme.desc: Mathilda ja Johannes pitävät taukoa, ja Mathilda yrittää ymmärtää mitä haluaa. Emil alkaa tapailla Lauraa muttei osaa selittää suhdettaan Yolandaan. Tähdillä roolitettu samannimisen 90-luvun elokuvan spin-off. Tässä modernissa draamakomediassa seuraamme 30-vuotiasta Mathildaa, joka panikoi vakaan ja värittömän aikuiselämän lähestyessä, kun hänen poikaystävänsä yllättäen kosii. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Opiskelijakämppä
programme.desc: Kaasuvuoto aiheuttaa ulkonaliikkumiskiellon. Jengi yrittää tappaa aikaa pelien avulla, mutta kaikki keskustelut johtavat riitaan. Kaaos vain laajenee. 20-vuotias Jenny jättää Eskilstunan lukeakseen psykologiksi Uppsalassa. Opiskelijakämpässä hän tapaa karismaattiset klubittajat Sagan ja Oliverin, jotka jo ensimmäisenä iltana houkuttelevat Jennyn tekemään päätöksen, jolla on tuhoisat seuraukset... Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Happy fucking Pride
programme.desc: “Not Today, Satan”. Dilan ja Ari ovat haudanneet sotakirveen. Nina viettää yhä enemmän aikaa Ziggyn kanssa ja päättää erota Saschasta - helpommin sanottu kuin tehty. Tukholma kuplii odotuksia Pride-viikon alkaessa. Treffejä odottava pikkukaupungin poika Dilan, näennäisen itsevarma mutta satutettu huippumeklari Ari ja tämän juuri jätetty kaveri Nina navigoivat vauhdikkaiden kesäpäivien ja kuumien kesäöiden läpi. Ruotsi 2024

programme.title: Käsi sydämellä
programme.desc: Kausi päättyy. Ava alkaa epäillä, voiko hän luottaa kykyynsä. Voiko hän saada Johnin takaisin vai onko tämä siirtynyt eteenpäin? Tukholmalaisella pariterapeutilla Avalla on yliluonnollinen kyky. Laittamalla käden ihmisen sydämelle hän näkee avainhetkiä tämän tulevasta rakkauselämästä. Itse hän on menettänyt uskon rakkauteen, kunnes eräänä päivänä näkee yllättävän näyn. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Lajka
programme.desc: Cajsan totuus Rutin toimistosta ja pomoista saa aikaan otsikoita somessa, ja koko henkilöstö kutsutaan kuulusteluun. Rut näkee kaaoksessa tilaisuuden. Felicia Danielssonin ja Vera Herngrenin satiirisarja. Saamme seurata ystävysten Rutin ja Cajsan päivittäisiä haasteita influencer-maailmassa. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Sokaistuneet
programme.desc: Dagbladetissa syntyy eturistiriita, kun Bea pyytää saada jatkaa tutkimuksiaan. Bea ei suostu lopettamaan vaan etsii käsiinsä Jonasin äidin. Carolina Neurathin todellisuuden innoittamaan romaaniin perustuva jännitysdraama nuoresta toimittajasta, joka ajautuu keskelle valtapelien, rahan ja salaisuuksien maailmaa. Tiivistunnelmaisen sarjan tähtinä Julia Ragnarsson ja Matias Varela. Ruotsi 2021

programme.title: Bäckström
programme.desc: Kotka on laskeutunut. Kausi päättyy. Pian paljastuu totuus murhista, huumesalakuljetuksesta ja kartellista. Saako Bäckström vastaukset, joita tarvitsee sielunrauhaansa varten? Ruotsalainen rikosdraama perustuu Leif G.W. Perssonin suosittuihin kirjoihin ristiriitaisesta ja omahyväisestä murhatutkijasta Evert Bäckströmistä, joka ratkoo rikoksia omintakeisella tyylillään. Ruotsi 2021

programme.title: Murha Sandhamnissa
programme.desc: Esther, osa 1. Maakellarista löytyy kaksi luurankoa. Kyse on 30 vuotta sitten rippileirillä kadonneista nuorista, ja koko ikäluokkaa kuulustellaan. Tukholman saaristo ei ole niin rauhallinen kuin luulit. Aaltojen lyödessä kallioita vasten rikostarkastaja syyttäjä Nora Linde taistelee arvaamatonta pahuutta vastaan. Ruotsi 2022

programme.title: Beck: Tuhkattu
programme.desc: Beck-ryhmä saa tutkittavakseen tapauksen, jossa pastori on kuollut Helluntaikirkon mailla tapahtuneessa tuhopoltossa. Rikospaikalle saapuvalle Alexille tapauksesta tulee henkilökohtainen, kun hän tapaa henkilön menneisyydestään. Avuksi rikostutkintaan Alex värvää mentorinsa Martin Beckin.

Täysin haiden lumoissa oleva hullu merikapteeni kidnappaa nuoren surffari Zephyrin ja pitää naista vankinaan keskellä merta. Zephyrin on keksittävä keino päästä pois, ennen kuin hänestä tulee hainruokaa. Ylistettyä kauhutrilleriä tähdittävät Hassie Harrison (Yellowstone) ja Jai Courtney (Suicide Squad, Divergent).

programme.title: Forensic Files: Silk Stalkings
programme.desc: Prompted by news of a flight attendant's brutal murder, the son of a previous victim contacts police. Both murders have similar MOs, and biological evidence proves that these were serial killings.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fishing for the Truth
programme.desc: A two-man shrimp boat sinks when a fast-moving, violent storm strikes the Louisiana coast. The captain drowns, but the deckhand is rescued fourteen hours later. The crewman is hailed as a hero — until the captain's body is discovered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: For Love or Money
programme.desc: When a wealthy real estate tycoon goes missing, it appears to be foul play. In his will, he leaves instructions in case he should die under violent circumstances — which were carried out after a hiker comes across his bullet-ridden skull.

programme.title: Forensic Files: South of the Border
programme.desc: The murder of an American tourist in a Mexican resort draws law enforcement resources on both sides of the border. At first glance, the motive appears to be robbery, but careful analysis of the forensic evidence points to something more sinister.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Stake-Out
programme.desc: Police are led on a wild goose chase when the wife of a prominent banker is kidnapped. An entomologist's unexpected discovery leads to a new suspect — and the realization that ordinary office equipment can leave extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Walking Terror
programme.desc: A neighbor watched as a man stabbed his wife, pushed her into the swimming pool and held her head under water. The husband, however, had no recollection of the crime. A jury would have to decide between evidence and the mysteries of the mind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Marked for Life
programme.desc: It would take 46 years, handwriting analysis and new fingerprint technology to solve the 1957 murders of two California police officers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Plastic Puzzle
programme.desc: A man riding a bicycle was fatally injured in what police believed to be a hit-and-run accident. Tiny clues found at the scene created a picture of the vehicle which struck him and led police to its driver.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: When an elderly couple died in a suspicious house fire, their son became the prime suspect. Investigators turned to forensic science to determine if the fire had been set deliberately, or if it was an unfortunate accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Soiled Plan
programme.desc: Police instituted an intense search when the mother of two young children went missing. Twenty years after her body was found, new technology recontextualized old evidence and pointed directly to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Headquarters
programme.desc: When hunters reported finding a skull in a Texas canyon, police immediately began an investigation. With a forensic artist's reconstruction, police eventually learned the victim's identity. Now all they had to do was find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: One for the Road
programme.desc: A married couple decided to escape the cold of winter with a mini-vacation in Key West. The wife went missing and police searched every square inch of the island; they found nothing but a pair of sandals which might have belonged to her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Army of Evidence
programme.desc: A mother of two young children was found dead in her bedroom. Her death was ruled a suicide — but when investigators learned she had almost died in a house fire three years earlier, they decided to take another look at the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shear Luck
programme.desc: In 1991, when the wife of a serviceman was brutally murdered in the Philippines, investigators had to reassemble a tiny computer disk that had been cut to pieces in order to find the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tagging a Suspect
programme.desc: Bombings are difficult to solve because the perpetrator isn't usually at the scene and the evidence goes up in smoke. In this case, pieces of plastic the size of grains of sand hold the key to finding a murderer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Strong Impressions
programme.desc: The wife of an Air Force officer was found dead in her bed with a plastic laundry bag near her face. Further investigation proved that the scene had been staged. Her death wasn't an accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cereal Killer
programme.desc: When a fire destroyed most of a home and a young boy went missing, police organized the largest search in the history of their small town. First the boy's backpack was discovered five miles from home, then his body was found 50 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Crash Course
programme.desc: A highway patrolman was dispatched to what he thought would be a routine traffic accident — until he looked in the car. He had seen hundreds of accidents, but none with as much blood as this.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Leg Up On Crime
programme.desc: The decomposed body of a young woman was discovered in a Bakersfield irrigation canal. If there was trace evidence, it had been washed away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tight-Fitting Genes
programme.desc: A behavioral profile caused the Baton Rouge Police Department to search for the wrong man. The real perpetrator may have eluded arrest, had it not been for a molecular biologist who painted DNA picture of the suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Valentine
programme.desc: An obstetrician returned home from the hospital and found his wife on the bathroom floor. She was covered with blood and not breathing. He tried unsuccessfully to revive her, staining his clothes with her blood in the process.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Picture This
programme.desc: A Modesto, California teenager goes missing. With no signs of struggle in her home, police suspect she has simply run away — until her naked, bruised body is discovered in a ditch 20 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Oily in the Morning
programme.desc: When police recovered the submerged car of a missing man, they expected to find his body — but it wasn't there. The investigation that followed would uncover an obsession turned deadly.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Gold Rush
programme.desc: Emergency dispatch received a call from a man who said his girlfriend shot and killed herself. The autopsy revealed that the gunshot wound was not self-inflicted, and the evidence on her body would give police a golden opportunity to catch her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Four on the Floor
programme.desc: When a Native American woman is brutally killed in the desert of New Mexico, her killers leave a crime scene rich in forensic evidence: tire tracks, shoe impressions and even the murder weapons.

programme.desc: Carly och Sam försöker få kycklingar att kläckas till ett naturkunskaps-projekt. Kycklingarna kläcks tidigare än väntat och rymmer från sin inkubator. Nu måste Carly, Sam, Freddie och Spencer leta efter kycklingar i hela lägenheten.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag vill inte bråka
programme.desc: Carly tillverkar en unik iCarly-T-shirt till Sam för att fira årsdagen av då de blev vänner. Men när Sam byter T-shirten mot konsertbiljetter, hamnar de två vännerna i bråk.

programme.desc: iCarly ber sina fans skicka in filmer av sig själva där de dansar sina coolaste danser. När över tretusen filmklipp kommer in, försöker Carly, Sam och Freddie sitta uppe hela natten för att se på alla filmerna.

programme.title: iCarly: Läskigt på Halloween
programme.desc: Carly, Sam och Freddie sänder iCarly från en våning som det ryktas att det spökar i. När läskiga saker börjar hända, blir vännerna rädda att spök-ryktena verkligen är sanna.

programme.title: iCarly: Ångra dagen
programme.desc: Spencer räddar livet på sångaren i The Plain White T's och får honom att gå med på att vara med i iCarly. Underliga saker börjar gå fel mitt i Carlys, Sams och Freddies webbsändning.

programme.title: iCarly: Kvarsittning
programme.desc: Sam får kvarsittning samma kväll som det är iCarlys spektakulära, femtionde webbshow. Eftersom de inte kan göra sin planerade webbshow, gör Carly och Freddie sitt bästa för att också få kvarsittning, så att de kan göra showen på kvarsittningen.

programme.title: iCarly: Skoskav
programme.desc: Carly, Sam och Freddie blir inbjudna till Dakas huvudkontor, där de blir erbjudna en stor summa pengar för att rekommendera Dakas nya sko, Tech-Foot, på iCarly. Men skon visar sig vara fruktansvärd.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag lovar att inte berätta
programme.desc: Carly får betyget B på en historieuppsats hon borde ha fått ett A på. Sam ser sin chans under sitt veckomöte med rektor Franklin, och ändrar Carlys betyg i datorn och överraskar henne med flera A.

programme.title: Deadliest Families: A Mother, A Murder & A Manhunt

Under en tid där världens uppmärksamhet är riktad mot händelser i Mellanöstern har CBN-tittarna uppskattat Chris Mitchells snabba rapporter från denna explosiva region i världen. Mitchell ger ett bibliskt och profetiskt perspektiv på dessa dagliga nyhetshändelser som formar vår värld.

programme.title: Love at First Lie

programme.title: Non-Stop
programme.desc: Henkeäsalpaava toimintatrilleri alkoholisoituneesta poliisista (Liam Neeson), jonka on yksin hoidettava lentokonekaappaus.

programme.title: Shelby Oaks
programme.desc: Riley ystävineen pitää The Paranormal Paranoids -nimistä YouTube-kanavaa, jossa tutkitaan yliluonnollisia mysteerejä. Yhden tutkimusretken aikana hän katoaa jäljettömiin ja muut ryhmän jäsenet löydetään kuolleina. Rileyn sisar Mia kieltäytyy luopumasta etsinnöistä ja suuntaa 12 vuotta myöhemmin hylättyyn Shelby Oaksiin. Kaupunkiin kätkeytyy karmiva salaisuus, jonka olisi pitänyt pysyä haudattuna.

programme.title: En enkel till Antibes
programme.desc: Draama leskimies Georgesta, joka saa tarpeekseen ihmisistä ympärillään, pakkaa laukun ja lähtee huikealle matkalle.

programme.title: On Set
programme.desc: Viihdeohjelma On Set vie Hollywoodin tähtitehtaan kulissien taakse. 2020

programme.title: New York, I Love You
programme.desc: New York on tehty kuolemattomaksi tuhansissa elokuvissa, ja se on ollut niin huumorin, draaman, väkivallan kuin runoudenkin näyttämö. "New York, I Love You" on samanlainen episodielokuva kuin "Pariisi, rakkaudella": se punoo yhteen yksitoista rakkaustarinaa ja tekee niistä persoonallisen rakkaudentunnustuksen tälle uskomattomalle kaupungille.

programme.title: Triangle of Sadness
programme.desc: Triangle of Sadness -elokuvassa mallipariskunta Carl ja Yaya lähtevät luksusristeilylle yhdessä miljonäärien, ystävällismielisten asekauppiaiden ja marxilaisen merikapteenin kanssa. Matkalla tapahtuva katastrofi saa ihmisten väliset hierarkiat äkkiä kääntymään päälaelleen jokaisen kamppaillessa omasta selviytymisestään. Ruben Östlundin (Turisti, The Square) kohuttu ja tarkkanäköinen draamakomedia.

programme.title: Britt-Marie kävi täällä
programme.desc: Draamakomedia Britt-Mariesta, joka jättää miehensä 40-vuotisen avioliiton jälkeen, muuttaa pikkukaupunkiin ja ryhtyy nuorten jalkapallovalmentajaksi.

programme.title: Göta Kanal 2
programme.desc: 25 vuotta sitten kaksi laivaa purjehti kilpaa Götan kanavan läpi. Tapaus nousi kuuluisuuteen sekä elokuvissa että videoilla. Nyt on uuden kilpailun aika, ja tällä kertaa laivoja seuraa tuotantoyhtiö, joka on tehnyt kilpailusta livenä lähetetyn saippuadokumentin. Vonna Jigert (Lena Endre), Tricks Televisionin häikäilemätön pomo, on pulassa ellei hänen uusimmasta ohjelmaideastaan tule niin suurta yleisösuosikkia kuin hän kaavaili. Anderssonin veneveistämö puolestaan on tuhon partaalla, ja konkurssi kolkuttaa jo ovella. Miljoonat ovat pelissä. On aika käynnistää moottorit ja aloittaa kamppailu kanavalla!

programme.title: Kunnian miehiä
programme.desc: Neljä Oscar-ehdokkuutta saanut, Rob Reinerin ohjaama draama, pääosissa Jack Nicholson, Tom Cruise ja Demi Moore.

programme.title: Terveysmatka
programme.desc: Pysyvästi tollo Stig Helmer ja hänen elämäniloinen norjalaiskaverinsa Ole ovat palanneet! Yhdessä he kokeilevat terveysbisneksen ja "new agen" uusia tuulia. Stig Helmer on eronnut, ja hän palaa Ruotsiin muuttuakseen todelliseksi sohvaperunaksi - tai sitä mieltä hänen äitinsä on. Stig Helmerille on kuitenkin tärkeämpää tietää, mitä uusi naapuri Rebecca on hänestä mieltä. Ehkä hänen on aika tehdä asialle jotain!

programme.title: Armoton maa
programme.desc: Cowboyt Boss, Charley, Mose ja Button kuljettavat karjaa 1880-luvun Keskilännessä. Mose lähetetään Harmonvilleen hakemaan tarvikkeita, mutta hän ei palaa. Miehet matkaavat kaupunkiin ja huomaavat, että Mose on pidätetty. Pian selviää, että sheriffi on korruptoitunut ja että aluetta hallitsee vaikutusvaltainen tilanomistaja. Yhteenotto on väistämätön.

programme.title: Hachiko – tarina uskollisuudesta
programme.desc: Hachiko-koira odottaa uskollisesti joka päivä juna-asemalla isäntäänsä. Eräänä päivänä isäntä ei saavukaan, ja Hachiko kieltäytyy lähtemästä asemalta. Se odottaa asemalla kokonaiset kymmenen vuotta: tarina uskollisesta koirasta on legenda.

programme.title: Erin Brockovich
programme.desc: Tositapahtumiin perustuva, Oscar-palkittu draama, jossa Julia Roberts on itseoppinut "asianajaja" sinnikkäässä taistelussa suurpääomaa vastaan.

programme.title: Kanavaralli - eli kuka poisti tapin veneestä?
programme.desc: Kaksi venettä taistelee railakkaasti Götan kanavan läpi klassikkokomediassa, jonka pääosissa ovat Janne "Loffe" Carlsson ja Magnus Härenstam. Arabiprinssi aikoo tilata jättimäärän ruotsalaisia moottoriveneitä. Selvittääkseen kenelle hän antaa tilauksen prinssi järjestää purjehduskilpailun kahden yrityksen välille: vastakkain ovat jättifirma Uniship ja pieni Anderssonin telakka. Prinssi haluaa, että kilpailijat yrittävät purjehtia Götan kanavan läpi niin nopeasti kuin mahdollista.

programme.title: Mig äger ingen
programme.desc: Ruotsi vuonna 1970. Lisa varttuu terästehtaalla työskentelevän Hasse-isänsä kanssa. Äiti jättää perheen, ja Hasse vajoaa syvemmälle murheisiin ja alkoholismiin. Isän ja tyttären välinen rakkaus ei silti haalistu. Mikael Persbrandt tekee yhden parhaista rooleistaan. Åsa Linderborgin omaelämäkerrallinen lapsuuselokuva palkittiin.

programme.title: Göta kanal 3 - Kanalkungens hemlighet
programme.desc: Kolmas osa äärettömän suositussa ruotsalaisessa komediasarjassa venejupakoista ja huijauksista Göta-kanavalla ja sen rannoilla.

programme.title: Populäärimusiikkia Vittulajänkältä
programme.desc: Reza Bagherin filmatisointi Mikael Niemen kirjasta, joka on villi kasvukertomus, jossa Niila ja Matti oppivat tuntemaan rock'n'rollia ja omaa seksuaalisuuttaan juominkien ja saunomisen välissä 1960-luvun Pajalassa.

programme.title: Polta nämä kirjeet
programme.desc: Tosipohjaiseen kirjaan perustuva ruotsalaisdraama 1930-luvulla eletystä intohimoisesta kolmiodraamasta, jonka jälkikaiut ulottuvat nykypäivään saakka.

programme.title: The Stig-Helmer story
programme.desc: Muutaman vaarallisen seuramatkan jälkeen sankarimme Stig-Helmer Olsson tekee paluun nostalgisella aikamatkalla nuoruusvuosiin.

programme.title: Järki ja tunteet
programme.desc: Rikas herra Dashwood kuolee ja jättää toisen vaimonsa ja kolme tytärtä puille paljaille. Jane Austenin romaaniin perustuva lämminhenkinen draama vuodelta 1995. Pääosissa: Emma Thompson, Kate Winslet, Alan Rickman, Hugh Grant.

programme.title: Beck: 58 minuuttia

programme.title: IFISH: Mulloway - Botany Bay, NSW

programme.title: The Way Way Back
programme.desc: 14 år gamle Duncan sliter med å passe inn i sin nye familesituasjon, med mor, hennes nye, nedlatende kjæreste, og hans datter. Mens moren blir stadig mer fraværende finner Duncan en usannsynlig venn i sjefen på badeanlegget hvor han har sommerjobb.

programme.title: Mrs Henderson Presents
programme.desc: En eksentrisk enke åpner et teater med dristige revyforestillinger, som utfordrer moralen i et krigsherjet 1930-talls London.

programme.title: Brad's Status
programme.desc: Brad (Ben Stiller) lever et komfortabelt liv i et villastrøk i Sacramento sammen med sin godmodige kone (Jenna Fischer) og sønnen (Austin Abrams). Livet forandres da han blir gjenforent med sine gamle venner.

programme.title: Familien Beliér
programme.desc: Alle i Paulas familie er døve, bortsett fra henne. Dette gjør at familien er ekstra sterkt knyttet til sammen og alle stoler på hennes hjelp, både hjemme, på gården de bor på og på markedet der de selger varene de produserer. En dag kommer Gabriel…

programme.title: Ghost Town
programme.desc: En spirituell romantisk komedie, Ghost Town er historien om Bertram Pincus, en gretten tannlege på Manhattan som utvikler den uønskede evnen til å se døde folk.

programme.title: The Lodger: A Story of the London Fog
programme.desc: En udlejer har mistanke om, at hendes nye logerende er galningen, der dræber kvinder i London.

programme.title: The Last Redemption
programme.desc: I et rige fyldt med magi og svig kæmper den frygtløse lovløse Diana mod den ondskabsfulde Lord Roland. Sammen med sine brødre og den unge ridder Tyrion begiver hun sig ud på et farligt eventyr for at redde prinsessen og riget.

programme.title: I Saw the Devil
programme.desc: En hemmelig agent hævner sig på en seriemorder ved hjælp af en række pågribelser og frigivelser.

programme.title: Island In The Sky
programme.desc: Filmen foregår efter anden verdenskrig, og John Wayne spiller Dooley, en tidligere militærpilot, der flyver fragtfly og bliver tvunget til at foretage en nødlanding på en frossen sø, fordi han løber tør for brændstof, og flyet kommer ud af kurs.

programme.title: Cold Zone
programme.desc: En storm er på vej. Ingen kan forudsige det. Ingen kan måle dens størrelse. Nu bliver en familie nødt til at overleve den. Og ingen kan søge ly fra stormen, ingen kommer ind fra kulden.

programme.title: Angreb! Er det bedste forsvar
programme.desc: To snobbede millionærer fra Rio de Janeiro bliver udsat for pengeafpresning. Heldigvis møder de Elliott Vance (Terence Hill) og Greg Wonder (Bud Spencer), som ligner dem på en prik, og de hyrer dem for en tid som stand-ins.

programme.title: Tyve & røvere

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Gravity
programme.desc: Gravity has long been a force that has intrigued scientists. Now, for the first time scientists are probing to detect gravity waves in space as well as mapping the gravity patterns of the moon.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Giant Planets: Lords of Gravity / Outer Limits: Edge of the Solar System
programme.sub-title: The Giant Planets: Lords of Gravity / Outer Limits: Edge of the Solar System
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Seasons of Saturn
programme.desc: Saturn is the second largest planet and has an astonishing 60 moons in its orbit. Thanks to the Cassini mission, it's also one of the most studied and most photographed planets in our neighborhood.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Return to the Moon
programme.desc: The moon is our closest celestial companion. It lights our night sky and gently tugs at our shores. Few have walked on her surface, but her allure remains strong.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Space: Getting There
programme.desc: The new surge in space transportation, privately owned companies vying for government contracts and private entrepreneurs looking to build hotels in space.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Project Mercury, The Mars Express & The Soyuz Launch System
programme.sub-title: Project Mercury, The Mars Express & The Soyuz Launch System
programme.desc: Project Mercury Begins - The start of NASA & America's first manned space program. Mars Express - The European Space Agency's Mars Satellite. The Soyuz Launch System - The gradual evolution of Russia's Soyuz launcher.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space
programme.sub-title: The Shuttle Program, The Challenger Disaster & Return to Space
programme.desc: The Shuttle Program - The first re-useable spacecraft. The Challenger Disaster - Pressing launch schedules lead to carelessness and the loss of the Challenger. Return to Space - A re-designed shuttle is back in space with a redefined role.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck
programme.sub-title: The Apollo Program Begins, Caves & Planck
programme.desc: The Apollo Program Begins - At the very beginning of NASA's moon project things go wrong. Caves - ESA's special training program for astronauts. Planck - Mapping the cosmic microwave background radiation.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training
programme.sub-title: Rebuilding Apollo, Orbiting Carbon & Zero Gravity Training
programme.desc: Rebuilding Project Apollo - After the Apollo 1 disaster NASA resumes manned space flight. Orbiting Carbon Observatory 2 - Monitoring the Earth's Co2 levels in unprecedented detail. Zero Gravity Training - Parabolic flights.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Landsat
programme.desc: Take a look at Landsat 8, the advanced planetary explorer with a 900 million dollar price tag! It is designed to peer across multiple wavelengths to reveal complex and ever-changing details that are undetectable by the human eye.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Milky Way
programme.desc: This episode traces our view of the Milky Way, from the mythology of ancient sky watchers to the efforts of scientists to map it from the inside out.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: From There to Here
programme.desc: The sky above is studded with stars and countless galaxies. In them, we can read not only our origin, but also our final destination. Technology is on the brink of taking us to places we have only dreamed of.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Moons of Olympus
programme.desc: There are many more worlds in our solar system than just the planets. The mysterious moons of the gas giants may hold much more than we ever imagined. Each one is unique, and each one deserves a scrutinous eye.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Shore to Shore
programme.desc: With low Earth orbit delegated to private companies, NASA is free to develop the deep space hardware for missions to Mars and beyond. The Orion space craft and SLS launch system are well on their way to delivering this capability.

programme.title: In the Shadow of the Moon
programme.desc: Between 1968 and 1972, the world watched in awe each time an American spacecraft voyaged to the Moon. Only 12 men walked upon its surface and they remain the only human beings to have stood on another world.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Hubble's Renaissance
programme.desc: Before we can reach space, we must first be able to see it. Hundreds of years ago, the simple telescope was used to give us a seemingly closer vantage. Today, we use the awe-inspiring, and super powerful, Hubble Space Telescope.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Vesta Unveiled
programme.desc: With the Dawn missions exploration of the asteroid Vesta and the dwarf planet Ceres, asteroids are a hot topic. See what these incredible missions have uncovered.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Science and the Shuttle
programme.desc: For more than 25 years the shuttle was our ticket to space, and our laboratory in orbit. Uncover the legacy of this amazing machine, and see what lies ahead.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: The Hot Zone
programme.desc: Mercury is one Earth's closest neighbors, but for centuries it eluded astronomer's best efforts to learn its secrets. But that has changed thanks to missions like Mariner and most recently, Messenger.

programme.title: Trajectory - Milestones in Space Exploration: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.sub-title: The Space Shuttle Matures, Complex Space Construction & The Final Years of the Space Shuttle
programme.desc: The Space Shuttle Matures - The Space Transportation System changes the nature of orbital missions. Complex Construction in Space - Confidence in the shuttle begins to return and engineers for get the lessons of the past.

programme.title: The Mystery of Dark Matter
programme.desc: Dark matter, which is unknown and undetectable in our physical models, would appear to populate the cosmos on a massive scale. For the first time, a film portrays the wild scientific quest that dark matter gives rise to - a real thriller!

programme.title: Moon Shots: Inside the Lost Apollo Archive
programme.desc: The world famous Apollo missions are some of the greatest feats ever accomplished by man. With rare archive footage and unprecedented access to life on board the Apollo spacecrafts, this stunning one-hour special brings scientific history to life.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Mars: Adapt or Leave
programme.desc: Air, water, food, electricity and fuel all the essentials to explore the solar system, this episode explores the innovative plans for astronauts to grow their own food and extract water and fuel at their destinations.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Inner Worlds
programme.desc: They orbit between our planet and our star. Mercury and Venus make up half of our terrestrial planets, but we still know very little about them. As we take a closer look at our companions, we find more questions than answers.

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: The Astronauts
programme.desc: Who are these people that venture into space? Once they were test pilots, then scientists and engineers now teachers, politicians and paying tourists what does it take to earn the astronaut wings?

programme.title: Space: The New Frontier: Edge of the Universe
programme.desc: The night sky is a time machine. The further we look out into the universe, the further back in time we reach. Most of what we see is actually dark matter and dark energy, but its nature eludes us... for the moment.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Rocky Shores / Silent Partner
programme.desc: See the sun, moon, planets, and galaxies through the eyes of intrepid machines that are blazing a trail across the solar system. A gateway to bold adventures, these cameras are delivering spectacular new cosmic vistas.

programme.title: Cosmic Vistas: Cosmic Rainbow
programme.desc: In the world of astronomy, how do we overcome the limits imposed by our own eyesight? The universe comes alive by viewing the cosmos in infrared light to gamma radiation.

programme.desc: Operation Cockade, led by MI6's double agent Henri Dericourt in 1943, aimed to deceive Germans with sabotage. Despite efforts, Germans withdrew divisions unconvinced. Dericourt faced a post-war treason trial and died in a mysterious 1962 plane crash.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Becoming Respectable

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Good Collaborators?

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Hitler's Biggest Blunder

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Aftermath
programme.desc: In WWII's final months, Allies discover Nazi death camps, prompting a sweeping denazification of Germany post-war. Nuremberg trials convict top Nazis. Former Nazis are employed by the West in the Cold War struggle against the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Naturligheder

programme.title: Skål for sandheden

programme.title: 2 Ristede

programme.title: Riis & Støiholm

programme.title: 2 Ristede
programme.desc: Allan og Dennis taler med Per Wind – tidligere målmand og træner i FC København, som deler gode fodboldhistorier og kærlighed til sporten og solen.

programme.title: Riis & Støiholm

programme.title: Endestationen

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: House of PI’s
programme.desc: Sabrina and Roxie are unexpectedly paired together to write a story in an effort to land a coveted spot on the school newspaper.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: The Halloween Scene
programme.desc: When Sabrina can’t find anyone to share her enthusiasm for Halloween she decides to throw her own haunted holiday bash and it turns into the party of the year.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Welcome Traveler
programme.desc: When Sabrina tries to pull Miles away from his latest conspiracy theory and into some semblance of a social life, she unknowingly pushes him right into the hands of a cult whose eccentric leader claims to be a witch.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Some of My Best Friends are Half-Mortals
programme.sub-title: Some of My Best Friends are Half-Mortals
programme.desc: Tired of hiding her true identity when dating mortal guys, Sabrina agrees to be fixed up by Zelda with a handsome and charming witch, Derek. The budding romance is dashed when she encounters racism over the fact that she is half-mortal.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Lost @ C
programme.desc: Sabrina is distraught when she receives her first “C” ever on a class assignment and turns to Zelda for counseling. Zelda ends up conducting her own private tutoring session with Sabrina’s handsome professor.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Sabrina’s Perfect Christmas
programme.desc: Sabrina opts to spend a picture-perfect Christmas with Morgan and her family rather than endure the annual insanity with Hilda and Zelda. She soon discovers the ugly secrets under the flawless façade.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: My Best Shot
programme.desc: Sabrina tries to give Josh a little confidence booster in his new passion to be a photographer, but her simple spell to help him make his first sale leads to his getting a big head and walking out on his job at the coffeehouse.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Tick-Tock Hilda’s Clock
programme.desc: When Sabrina throws Hilda a surprise party for her 650th birthday, Hilda becomes depressed that she doesn’t have a husband or family yet. Things go from bad to worse when Sabrina loses the out-of-whack biological clock.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Sabrina’s New Roommate
programme.desc: When Sabrina reluctantly takes in Zelda for a few days while Hilda’s on a home remodeling binge, Sabrina and her roommates try to loosen up her uptight Aunt Zelda.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Making the Grade
programme.desc: Sabrina tries to right a wrong when she writes an article for the school paper exposing the preferential treatment given to school athletes, but she inadvertently puts Roxie's scholarship in jeopardy.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Love is a Many Complicated Thing
programme.sub-title: Love is a Many Complicated Thing
programme.desc: Sabrina agrees to a double date on Valentine's Day with Josh and Morgan, but by the end of the date she finds herself in the middle of her friends' break up.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Sabrina the Muse
programme.desc: Sabrina is flattered when her new boyfriend writes music about his feelings for her, but the pressure to inspire him as his muse becomes a one-sided relationship.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Beach Blanket Bizarro
programme.desc: Sabrina’s wild visions of her first college spring break turn squeaky-clean when her aunts ask 60’s teen idol Frankie Avalon to put a spell on the trip. This sends Sabrina and her friends into a world straight out of a 60’s beach movie.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Witchright Hall
programme.desc: When Sabrina’s trouble-making teenage cousin Amanda is sent to live with Hilda and Zelda, they count on Sabrina to convince the headmaster and school director of Witchright Hall to accept Amanda.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Sabrina the Activist
programme.desc: Sabrina, who is now in low spirits over her heavy course load and recent break up, decides to put her energy into something positive: leading a protest to save an historical building from demolition.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Do You See What I See?
programme.sub-title: Do You See What I See?
programme.desc: Sabrina feels responsible when Miles considers giving up his paranormal research to settle in his father’s accounting business after no one believes the otherworldly phenomena he sees at the Spellman home.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Sabrina’s Got Spirit
programme.desc: Sabrina tries to throw off Miles and the specialist he has hired to uncover paranormal activity in the house, but Sabrina herself discovers a ghost in the ceiling.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Finally!
programme.desc: Romance brews between Sabrina and Josh when they turn the coffeehouse into a single's night featuring entertainment by the band Eden's Crush.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: The Really Big Season Opener
programme.desc: Miles decides to make a student film in his favorite genre, horror, and enlists Sabrina as the producer of his film.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Sabrina’s Date with Destiny
programme.desc: Sabrina and her friends return to school and a lot of excitement after summer break.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: What’s News?

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: Murder on the Halloween Express
programme.desc: Hilda and Zelda are invited to attend a murder mystery party on the Halloween Mystery Train, which makes a stop in Boston.

programme.title: Sabrina the Teenage Witch: The Gift of Gab
programme.desc: Sabrina and Roxie are thrilled to get their own show on the campus radio station, a two hour talk show they call "Chick Chat."

programme.desc: Sabrina finds herself in a jam when ex-boyfriend Harvey requests that she use her magical powers to help him.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Captain Tony Nelson, an astronaut, is engaged to Melissa Stone, daughter of General Wingard Stone, his commanding officer. Tony is rocketed into space in a capsule which lands is the Pacific. He reaches a small island. There he releases Jeannie, a beautiful blonde, who can perform magic with a blink of her eyes, from a bottle is which she has been imprisoned for ages. Jeannie tells Tony she is his slave forever. Worried about Jeannie's effect on Melissa and his career, Tony tries to leave Jeannie behind on the island, but she smuggles herself aboard the rescue plan. Questioned about his reactions in space by the base psychiatrist, Dr. Alfred Bellows, Tony tells about his meeting with Jeannie. Feeling that Tony is suffering from hallucinations, Bellows calls General Stone.Jeannie appears at Tony's home. Tony tries frantically to keep General Stone, Melissa, Doctor Bellows and Captain Roger Henley, a fellow astronaut, from seeing Jeannie. His problems reach a climax when Jeannie produces a harem of dancing girls to perform for Tony. After Tony works his way out of that, Melissa and her father leave, feeling a vacation, combined with a honeymoon, will solve Tony's problems. Tony orders Jeannie to leave no doubt that she is determined to be a part of Tony's life for a long time.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.desc: Jeannie blinks Tony to ancient Persia to defend her honor while Jeannie announces to her parents that this is the man she plans to marry.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized)
programme.sub-title: Guess What Happened On The Way To The Moon
programme.desc: To test man's ability to survive on the moon, Captain Anthony (Tony) Nelson, and his fellow astronaut, Captain Roger Healey, are ordered to spend a week, in Furnace Canyon, Nevada, 100 degrees in the daytime, 10 below freezing at night. Except for water, they are to live off the land. Jeannie hides in Tony's canteen. Tony tries to make Jeannie understand that she is destroying the value of the mission, but she sticks with him. While Roger barely survives, Tony has every luxury, from food and a harem tent, to a final ride on a camel to finish the journey.Dr. Bellows is baffled to find that while Roger has lost twelve pounds, Tony has gained five. When Tony tries to explain Jeannie's presence, Dr. Bellows concludes that he has the imagina-tion men need to survive on the moon and recommends Tony for a more arduous test, Operation Extinction. Tony tells Jeannie he is taking her with him, but imprisons her within her bottle, de-termined to go on the mission alone.

programme.title: Stugfixarna Norge: Avsnitt 202

programme.title: Stugfixarna Norge

programme.title: Stugfixarna Norge: Avsnitt 204

programme.title: Stugfixarna Norge

programme.title: Stugfixarna Norge
